newsitem.title: UK: BA still undecided on cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: BA still undecided on cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo is still considering whether or not to maintain its cargo fuel surcharge, a spokesman said.
"There is no change for the time being," he told Reuters.
BA is now the only major European carrier which has not decided to lift the surcharge introduced last November 8 to compensate for sharply higher jet fuel prices.
The British carrier applied a six pence per kg surcharge on intercontinental rates and three pence a kg on European and UK routes.

Since Thursday afternoon, Lufthansa Cargo, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV, Swisscargo and Air France have all announced they are dropping the surcharge with effect from next Tuesday -- April 15 -- as fuel prices having fallen back to last July's level.
And SAS said that it will follow these other airlines.
Earlier today Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said it was dropping its ex-UK five pence a kg surcharge in force since November 25 with effect from May 1.
Air Canada said it was also scrapping its surcharge from April 15. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
